title: Auto-Cast Spells
summary: Optional deterministic spell automation toggled in Settings (Off, Per-Spell, or Smart) and bound per spell via desktop Right-Click or mobile Long-Press, marked with a rotating rune border on the hotkey bar.

p: Optional deterministic spell automation toggled in Settings (Off, Per-Spell, or Smart) and bound per spell via desktop Right-Click or mobile Long-Press, marked with a rotating rune border on the hotkey bar.

list: Healing spells (Healing, Healing Rain) target the lowest-HP squad member at or below 65% HP within cast range.
Defensive buffs (Stone Skin, Blessing, Haste, Wind Ward) refresh unbuffed allies while actively in combat.
Offensive bolts (Fire Bolt, Frost Bolt, Lightning, Marrow Dart) fire in place of wand shots while conserving the 15% mana reserve for emergencies.

title: Auto-Go to Objective
summary: Optional A* path-navigation assist (Off or On in Settings) that marches the hero and squad toward the active mission waypoint while Ambush Guard halts in combat-ready formation the instant any foe enters sight.
infobox: Any manual move or order click

p: Optional A* path-navigation assist (Off or On in Settings) that marches the hero and squad toward the active mission waypoint while Ambush Guard halts in combat-ready formation the instant any foe enters sight.

Designed for effortless mobile traversal across cleared corridors without walking blindly into ambushes. Manual right-clicks or touch commands cancel Auto-Go immediately so purists always retain command.

title: Auto-Fight Modes
summary: Configurable squad autonomy selector in Main Menu and Pause Menu Settings with three modes: Off / Manual for pure classic RTS control, Self-Defense for adjacent retaliation, and Tactical AI for autonomous engagements.

p: Configurable squad autonomy selector in Main Menu and Pause Menu Settings with three modes: Off / Manual for pure classic RTS control, Self-Defense for adjacent retaliation, and Tactical AI for autonomous engagements.

list: Off / Manual: Zero automated combat decisions; every move, target switch, and cast stays 100% manual.
Self-Defense: Squad units strike back when attacked in reach without breaking formation or chasing across the map.
Tactical AI: Hero and mercenaries acquire visible enemies, prioritize dangerous casters or wounded targets, and weave assigned skills.

title: Auto-Loot Sweep & Loot Sweep [F]
summary: Optional post-combat item pickup setting (and manual F hotkey / HUD button) that sweeps nearby gold piles, belt potions, and loot sacks once no enemies remain within an 8-tile radius.

p: Optional post-combat item pickup setting (and manual F hotkey / HUD button) that sweeps nearby gold piles, belt potions, and loot sacks once no enemies remain within an 8-tile radius.

Automatically routes belt-eligible healing and mana potions into open belt slots, adds gold directly to the war chest, and bags dropped equipment sacks into hero inventory without tedious individual taps on mobile screens.

title: Auto-Potion Belt Threshold
summary: Optional Settings assist allowing belt healing potions to fire automatically when hero health falls below 0 (Off), 30%, or 45%, protecting commanders during hectic multi-front fights.

p: Optional Settings assist allowing belt healing potions to fire automatically when hero health falls below 0 (Off), 30%, or 45%, protecting commanders during hectic multi-front fights.
Set the threshold to 0 (Off) for strict manual hotkey potion timing, or select 30% / 45% on mobile touchscreens where quick-slotting during AoE targeting is tight.

title: Squad Stances (H / G / A)
summary: Classic three-tier tactical leash system letting players switch selected mercenaries between Hold Ground [H] (0-tile melee chase for bridge blocks), Guard / Defensive [G] (3-tile anchor leash), and Aggressive [A] (9-tile pursuit).

p: Classic three-tier tactical leash system letting players switch selected mercenaries between Hold Ground [H] (0-tile melee chase for bridge blocks), Guard / Defensive [G] (3-tile anchor leash), and Aggressive [A] (9-tile pursuit).
Hold Ground prevents melee spear-carriers and shield guards from stepping off narrow bridges or gate gaps, letting archers and mages bombard trapped packs in safety.

title: Regroup to Hero [R]
summary: Squad emergency formation command triggered by [R] or the mobile HUD Regroup button, initiating a 1.5-second disengage that rallies allies into a disciplined two-rank guard around the hero.

p: Squad emergency formation command triggered by [R] or the mobile HUD Regroup button, initiating a 1.5-second disengage that rallies allies into a disciplined two-rank guard around the hero.
Heavy melee warriors and frontliners snap to the forward arc facing threats while ranged bowmen and spellcasters settle behind the hero, rescuing overextended mercenaries before boss cleaves.

title: High Ground Tactical Advantage
summary: Terrain elevation combat modifier using map height differences: firing downhill with >= +2 height steps grants +1.5 tile range, +15% accuracy, and +10% crit chance, while firing uphill by >= 2 steps applies a -15% accuracy penalty.

p: Terrain elevation combat modifier using map height differences: firing downhill with >= +2 height steps grants +1.5 tile range, +15% accuracy, and +10% crit chance, while firing uphill by >= 2 steps applies a -15% accuracy penalty.
Claiming quarry ledges, river bluffs, and caldera terraces swings skirmishes decisively in your favor — especially when pairing archers with Hold Ground [H] blockers below.

title: Mercenary Veterancy Ranks & Perks
summary: Persistent mercenary progression tracking lifetime kills and survived missions across four ranks — Recruit, Veteran, Elite, and Champion Guard — displaying SquadBar chevron badges and unlocking passive class perks.
infobox: Shield Wall · Double Draw · Arcane Conduit

p: Persistent mercenary progression tracking lifetime kills and survived missions across four ranks — Recruit, Veteran, Elite, and Champion Guard — displaying SquadBar chevron badges and unlocking passive class perks.

list: Shield Wall: Frontline guards mitigate incoming physical cleaves and brace adjacent allies in tight formations.
Double Draw: Veteran archers gain rapid-nock volley cadence and heightened target priority on ranged foes.
Arcane Conduit: Battle mages and adepts siphon mana faster and amplify elemental bolt potency.

title: Temple Resurrection
summary: Town Arcane Sanctum and Temple service that revives fallen mercenaries for a gold tithe, preserving their persistent kill tally, veterancy chevrons, perks, and personal equipment instead of replacing them with raw recruits.

p: Town Arcane Sanctum and Temple service that revives fallen mercenaries for a gold tithe, preserving their persistent kill tally, veterancy chevrons, perks, and personal equipment instead of replacing them with raw recruits.
While cheap recruits can be hired afresh, a Champion Guard carrying hard-won perks and a high-tier charm slot is far stronger and retains continuity across the campaign and Endgame Vault.

title: Mercenary Charm & Auto-Potion Slots
summary: Personal mercenary inventory slots granting each companion one Charm or Ring slot for passive resistances and stats plus two healing potion slots that auto-trigger whenever the mercenary drops below 30% HP.

p: Personal mercenary inventory slots granting each companion one Charm or Ring slot for passive resistances and stats plus two healing potion slots that auto-trigger whenever the mercenary drops below 30% HP.
Stocking belt potions on tank mercenaries lets them weather Act III–IV boss bursts autonomously without consuming hero spell cooldowns every few seconds.

title: The Holy Grail & Five Imperial Tomes
summary: Account-wide endgame collector compendium tracking every distinct Unique Artifact (132), Sacred Set (28), Rune & Crafted Runeword (33 + 25), Boss Trophy (20), and Imperial Armory Base (187) with full Live Wiki Sync and Save Backup export.
infobox: Uniques · Sets · Runes & RW · Bosses · Armory

p: Account-wide endgame collector compendium tracking every distinct Unique Artifact (132), Sacred Set (28), Rune & Crafted Runeword (33 + 25), Boss Trophy (20), and Imperial Armory Base (187) with full Live Wiki Sync and Save Backup export.

list: Tome I — Unique Artifacts: 132 named relics across all four acts.
Tome II — Sacred Sets: 28 multi-piece class sets and set completion racks.
Tome III — Runes & Crafted Runewords: 33 runes and 25 socketed runewords unlocked upon forging.
Tome IV — Boss Trophies & Super-Uniques: 20 apex boss seals across Normal, Hard, and Nightmare.
Tome V — Imperial Armory: 187 base weapons, armors, shields, charms, and arcane tomes.

title: Target-Farming Clues & Grail Pins
summary: Discovery guidance replacing blank ??? slots with icon silhouettes, rumored Act/Boss Drop Clues, and the ability to pin up to 3 missing items as Active Grail Targets to highlight matching missions, Tavern Bounties, and Wiki panels.

p: Discovery guidance replacing blank ??? slots with icon silhouettes, rumored Act/Boss Drop Clues, and the ability to pin up to 3 missing items as Active Grail Targets to highlight matching missions, Tavern Bounties, and Wiki panels.

Every item, unique, set, gem, and bestiary article displays its live Grail status and lets you Pin Grail Targets directly. On the battlefield, uncollected Grail items drop with a gold-purple star beam and choral discovery chime.

title: Roll Perfection & Primal Foil Frames
summary: Provenance and quality tracking attached to every Grail discovery ({ hero, class, level, mission, boss, rollPerfectionPct }), firing Grail Record Broken alerts on upgrades and awarding a Primal Gold-Purple Foil Frame for >= 98% rolls.

p: Provenance and quality tracking attached to every Grail discovery ({ hero, class, level, mission, boss, rollPerfectionPct }), firing Grail Record Broken alerts on upgrades and awarding a Primal Gold-Purple Foil Frame for >= 98% rolls.
Even after finding a Unique relic once, higher-rolled drops break your personal % Perfection record and stamp the Live Wiki banner with your victorious hero and encounter provenance.

title: Holy Grail Milestone Boons & Replica Forging
summary: Account-wide progression rewards unlocked at 10%, 25%, 50%, 75%, and 100% Holy Grail completion, granting escalating Magic Find, Smart Grail Pity, Reliquary Replica Forging, and exclusive Grail Guardian Bounties.
infobox: Sovereign Crown · Town Aura · Hall of Fame

p: Account-wide progression rewards unlocked at 10%, 25%, 50%, 75%, and 100% Holy Grail completion, granting escalating Magic Find, Smart Grail Pity, Reliquary Replica Forging, and exclusive Grail Guardian Bounties.

At 50% Grail completion, Reliquary Replica Forging lets new heroes commission a replica of a previously discovered Unique once per Act using gold and runes, turning Grail mastery into tangible power across fresh runs.

title: Tavern Bounty Contracts
summary: Regional Super-Unique hunting contracts posted in town taverns across all four acts, sending squads after named apex monsters for guaranteed rune, rare, or unique rewards — flagged automatically when matching pinned Grail Targets.

p: Regional Super-Unique hunting contracts posted in town taverns across all four acts, sending squads after named apex monsters for guaranteed rune, rare, or unique rewards — flagged automatically when matching pinned Grail Targets.
Once you pass the 25% Grail milestone, Smart Grail Pity biases Bounty Boss loot toward missing relics, and reaching 75% unlocks four high-stakes Grail Guardian Bounty Contracts.

title: Mystery Gamble & Smart Grail Pity
summary: Town merchant gold-sink tab letting commanders wager gold on mystery item slots with chances at magic, rare, Sacred Set, and Unique outcomes — boosted by Smart Grail Pity (+25% weight toward missing Grail items) once 25% Grail is reached.

p: Town merchant gold-sink tab letting commanders wager gold on mystery item slots with chances at magic, rare, Sacred Set, and Unique outcomes — boosted by Smart Grail Pity (+25% weight toward missing Grail items) once 25% Grail is reached.
Turns late-campaign gold surpluses into focused target-farming rolls for specific weapon or armor slots needed to complete Sacred Sets and the Five Tomes.
